status: frozen before the first Freebase vector is encoded

encoding.text: the Freebase node `name` string, verbatim (UTF-8), one text per distinct name
encoding.batching: sentence-transformers sorts each encode() call by character length and cuts consecutive batches; one call per chunk
encoding.tokenizer: the model's own (padding side as shipped)

ordering.unit: distinct name; row r has first position first_pos[r]; ptr[p] = row of position p (results/FREEBASE_SCALE/names/FBX_NAME_DEDUP__v1.json); node-ID ordering = position = canonical row order of the node shards

representation.kind: OPQ rotation (faiss OPQMatrix(1536, m), niter 20) + ProductQuantizer(1536, m, 8 bit)
representation.holdout: RandomState(1) draw of min(n_distinct_rows, 10256) rows, training rows removed, first 256 kept, sorted (float fp16 kept for measurement only)
representation.quantise: fp16 -> fp32 renormalise -> y = x A^T -> pq.compute_codes
representation.float_policy: no float chunk is kept: a chunk's vectors are quantised and discarded; only the training sample and the holdout stay as fp16

calibration_evidence.note: the WebQSP end-to-end calibration (addenda 6/6A) accepts this m

chunk_record: per chunk: row range, vector count, names sha256 (length-prefixed UTF-8), codes sha256, model revision, contract sha256, codebook sha256, seconds; files codes_<c>.npy + chunk_<c>.json under data/freebase_scale/enc/chunks/
